name: How to Want Something Warm
source:
A short project I wrote and put together back in early June, as a sort of impromptu "pride month" release about eccentricity and gay love and how it can be transformative. It features Emil, a neurodivergent and reclusive taxidermist, and Isaac, his lonely but curious client. What does love look like in places still and quiet? How does one explain the sensations of being understood? What is this feeling?

[From [url=https://droptineart.itch.io/how-to-want-something-warm]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
我在六月初编写并整理了一个简短的项目，作为一种即兴的“骄傲月”发布，内容涉及古怪和同性恋之爱以及它如何能够带来变革。它的主角是埃米尔（Emil），一位神经分歧且隐居的动物标本剥制师，以及艾萨克（Isaac），他孤独但好奇的客户。在安静的地方，爱情是什么样子的？如何解释被理解的感觉？这是什么感觉？

[来自[url=https://droptineart.itch.io/how-to-want-something-warm]Itch.io[/url]]
